basis: Manual inspection of unchanged Rust source before looking up these functions' report diagnostics. Counts are independent labels; absent diagnostics never supply numeric zero facts.

samples.basis: Two shared inputs; next mutably borrows the one local iterator at two call sites.
Four shared/value arguments and immutable local results; path joining does not mutate an input root.
One shared slice argument; sort_by mutably borrows the owned ordered vector.
Two inputs; insert mutates the captured seen set inside the iterator callback.
One shared CLI input; local vectors and iterator adapters move values without mutably borrowing a named root.
Two shared inputs; filesystem writes are effects, not source-root mutation. No purity claim is made.
Two parameters; +=/-= write through depth, index advances, and |= updates the owned boolean. These are three distinct roots regardless of loop iterations.
Two inputs; a read-only iterator chain constructs the output string without mutable source-root access.
Three inputs; requested.insert and selected.push mutably borrow two distinct owned containers. Neither is an escaping write.
Two inputs; the loop pushes into the distinct owned exact and named vectors. Moving a selected vector into matches adds no mutable root.
Two inputs; pop/extend mutate pending, and insert mutates seen. Repeated visits add events but do not add distinct targets.

preconditions: These selected original functions are unsuppressed and outside the explicit target/** exclusion. Only selected check units are comparable; missing/ambiguous/unknown functions must remain unavailable.
limitations: Eleven source-inspected functions, twenty-two rule checks; no project-wide precision/recall, density-quality, effect-absence or refactoring-safety claim. Mutably borrowing an owned local still counts under this compiler metric.
